ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central notch area, leading edges, and distal tips (approx. 25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity bifurcation extending from the median notch toward the peduncle. Dense black mottling and stippling along the leading edges and outer lobes. Sparse, localized black pixel clusters (stippling) distributed across the white medial fields of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable deep-amplitude indentation (notch) located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 60% of the distance from the notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad sigmoid curve exhibiting concavity near the median notch transitioning to convex sweep toward the tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast black circular pixel groups on the right lobe medial-distal region, consistent with localized scarring patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe; several faint vertical linear streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the right trailing edge; dark, textured distal encrustations on both tips likely indicating parasitic or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a thin, reddish-brown linear object (biological debris) trailing from the leftmost tip of the fluke.
